notes: v1.0.22 — manual GCash payment fraud hardening (T5)
- Closed the remote route into the manual GCash confirmation flow by
revoking EXECUTE on the dormant create_gcash_checkout RPC (no new
manual awaiting_payment_confirmation orders can be created from
anywhere; legacy Aug 8–9 orders still resolve).
- POS GCash reference-number dedupe: partial unique index on
orders.gcash_reference_number scoped to paid, non-empty references —
a reference can never confirm a second paid order. The seller's
GCash confirm now surfaces a clear "reference already used" error.
- New admin-only gcash_payment_decision_audit table: RLS via
is_admin() SELECT-only, all write grants revoked including
service_role; written server-side by a POS confirm trigger and the
confirm/reject RPCs, capturing the reference number and the order
total at decision time. Retrospective pattern detection only — not
alerting.
- Seller queue screen: prominent expected-amount banner directly
above the Confirm/Reject buttons (mitigation to reduce seller error,
not a technical control — no gateway in this flow).
